messages:
maria: Promo blocked by CI: deploy-bot reported 'artifact verification failed' during promote step. seeing checksum mismatch for shard upload 3/8. Need quick triage, release window at 16:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: [auto] Promotion halted: status=blocked, reason=artifact-verify-failure, job=promote-v2.2.1, attempt=1. See: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/98765

raj: I can take a look. quick guess—multipart upload partial commit or s3 object metadata TTL mismatch. grabbing logs.

maria: thanks. logs show `Manifest checksum: e3b0c442` vs uploaded `e3b0c441` for layer-3.tar.gz

raj: hmm, that's a single-byte diff. Could be gzip rounding or aborted reupload. Who triggered concurrent reupload?

tess: I saw a watchdog retry at 15:12 that retried failed chunks; might've interleaved with the deploybot reupload.

sam: If it's just one shard, two quick options: 1) pin to last-good image and manual promote, or 2) reupload artifact with cache-bust and re-trigger promote. Pin is fastest for the window.

maria: customer-facing release notes include a tiny AE fix, prefer not to delay. I'm leaning pin. Any risk?

raj: pin -> low risk. We should record a revert plan. If we pin, set label `manual-promote:stalled-shard-pin-6423456789` and create follow-up to reingest artifacts and reconcile checksums.

tess: +1. Also add a short CI postmortem ticket: PRODENG-2345. I'll create it and assign to infra for artifact revalidation.

sam: Steps to pin: 1) deploy-bot promote --image sha256:abc123 --force-pin --note "stalled shard checksum mismatch" 2) set release flag in console 3) kick off reupload job `ci/artifact-repair --shard 3 --source s3://builds/tmp/98765`

maria: can someone run the promote command and confirm console flag? I'll draft release notes and update PMs.

raj: running promote now.

deploy-bot: [auto] Manual promote accepted by raj. promote job queued. note="stalled shard checksum mismatch"

raj: promote succeeded. release marked `promoted-by:raj:manual-pin`. Leaving a follow-up in PRODENG-2345 to reupload and validate original artifact.

maria: great—thanks all. Will update release channel and docs. :party-parrot:

tess: filed PRODENG-2345 with initial triage notes and assigned to infra. Link: https://tickets.internal/PRODENG-2345

sam: once infra revalidates, we should run a canary re-promo flow to swap layer if needed. For now, unblocking release window.

maria: closing thread — will post final release notes when publish completes.
